units.source_text: 最有效的，不用说是由上往下切削而去。

en.t: The most effective way, needless to say, would be to cut down from the top.

units.source_text: 但这样不行的话，那就只有从下朝上挖了。

en.t: But if that would not work, then the only choice was to dig upward from below.

units.source_text: 首先在下面随意地挖一个洞，等待沙子从上面滑落，

en.t: First, dig a hole more or less at random down below, and wait for the sand to slide down from above,

units.source_text: 下面再挖，上面的沙子再滑落……

en.t: then dig again below, and the sand above would slide down again...

units.source_text: 这样反复地做下去，脚下的沙子就会渐渐增高，

en.t: If he kept repeating this, the sand under his feet would gradually rise,

units.source_text: 什么时候总能到达上面吧。

en.t: and sooner or later he ought to be able to reach the top.

units.source_text: 当然，半路上也有被沙流冲走的危险。

en.t: Of course, there was also the danger of being swept away by a flow of sand halfway through.

units.source_text: 可不管沙子怎样流动，它肯定与水的流动不一样。

en.t: But no matter how sand flowed, it certainly was not the same as the flow of water.

units.source_text: 还从没听说过人被沙子淹死的事呢。

en.t: After all, he had never heard of anyone drowning in sand.
